description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Elesh Norn to an opponent.
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Karmic Guide's enter-the-battleifeld ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
